description: This file contains utility functions for handling Windows Media Foundation media types, including GUID conversions, attribute string representations, and property copying between media types.

methods.name: GuidToFallbackString
methods.description: Converts a GUID to a string, using StringFromCLSID.

methods.name: MfGuidToString
methods.description: Converts a GUID to a human-readable string, using predefined mappings or fallback.

methods.name: ImfAttributesToString
methods.description: Converts IMFAttributes to a string representation for debugging.

methods.name: CopyProperties
methods.description: Copies all attributes from one IMFMediaType to another.
